population_name: MATRIX vision exact-image-disjoint diagnostic universe (not paper-disjoint verified)
eligibility: All 250 released vision test QAs minus every test image whose LFS SHA256 also occurs in a referenced train/val QA. No filtering by answer content, apparent difficulty, model output or reviewer agreement.
paper_provenance: No paper IDs, DOI, source URLs or figure-to-paper mapping in any JSONL record or additional metadata file in the complete pinned tree.
near_duplicate_screening: Not performed; byte inequality does not imply visual or paper independence.
